epoch: one random window (of those holding target cells) from every fit tile; one optimiser step per tile
per-epoch evaluation: a fixed seeded subset of 2 target windows per inner-fold-1 tile
optimiser: AdamW (weight decay 0.05 blocks, 1e-4 head), gradient norm clipped at 1, float32
early stopping / cut-off tiles: inner fold 1 of nested_spatial_folds / nested_cell_folds (seed 662) inside each outer-training fold; fit on the other 4 inner folds' tiles
Track B cross-fitting: the outer fold's 5 inner folds: model j is fit on the outer-training tiles outside inner fold j (targets: inner-training roads, purged) and gives inner fold j's cues; held-out roads take the mean of the 5 models' probability grids
Track B targets: the roads production's cloud rule assesses, among each model's (purged) training roads
